evidence.title: Skanska builds data center expansion in Espoo, Finland for EUR 100M, about SEK 1.1 billion
evidence.excerpt: Skanska reports that construction of the atNorth FIN02 expansion in Espoo began in April 2026 with core-and-shell work and preparatory fit-out work.
